notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (Total Governmental Funds, p5); transfers_in is the printed net 'Transfers from (to) other funds' 84,635. ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and cash equivalents' 807,773 (p4); certificates of deposit 945,356 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 19,232 not included. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (p9); no single total receipts line printed, so receipts total = operating revenues + nonoperating interest and contributions (computed); disbursements total = Statement of Activities business-type expenses 1,496,859 (p2). Utility 'Other revenue' 34,857 is charges for services: SoA charges for services 1,613,505 = 1,578,648 + 34,857. Detail: General Fund taken from the GAAP-basis departmental combining statement (pp18-19, ties to statement p5); the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p14) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Street and Airport from their budgetary comparison schedules (budgetary basis, pp15-16); CDBG and Hospital Bond Sinking from the nonmajor combining statement (p17). Department transfers in the GF departmental statement net to 40,050. Component unit (CRA) excluded. Read pages 1-19 of 19
